subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should ClawHub rotate production GitHub OAuth to an officially controlled app now, or explicitly confirm that the currently personal-branded app is organization-controlled and approved for continued use?
rationale: Only a maintainer with GitHub OAuth-app and production-secret authority can verify ownership, safely rotate credentials, and decide whether the current trust presentation is acceptable.

options.title: Audit and rotate to official ownership
options.body: Verify the current app and production callback, create or transfer an officially owned OAuth App, rotate the deployed credentials, and validate fresh web plus CLI login.

options.title: Document an approved exception
options.body: Retain the existing app only after confirming organization control and recording why its personal consent branding is acceptable for this user-facing authorization flow.

recommendation.title: Audit and rotate to official ownership
recommendation.body: Verify the current app and production callback, create or transfer an officially owned OAuth App, rotate the deployed credentials, and validate fresh web plus CLI login.

likelyOwner.reason: The consent screen directly identifies this account as the OAuth app owner, making it the best available routing contact for an ownership and rotation decision.
